speaker: Doctor
text: I see, so you have no history of hearing issues or ear problems, which helps rule out Meniere's disease. The absence of neurological deficits and auditory symptoms strongly points toward Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo. Let me confirm this by performing a physical exam; please lie back on the table and quickly turn your head to the right while I lift your head slightly off the pillow.
